title: Registry Configuration
description: Declares how a component registry extends the base spec.

designSystem.description: The design system this registry covers

package.description: npm package carrying the pinned design-system release (e.g. @uswds/uswds). Its devDependency must match designSystem.version exactly — the validator cross-checks the pin (protocol.md Design-System Version Sync).

agentMetaId.description: The HTML id of the embedded metadata block (e.g., 'uswds-agent-meta')

facets.description: List of facet field names to aggregate in facets.json

metadataSchemaVersion.description: Metadata schema version for tile agent-meta blocks. v1 = flat structure, v2 = categorized (discovery/selection/instruction/constraints)

taxonomyVersion.description: Optional taxonomy version for the facet vocabulary

staticView.description: Resolved-view generation inputs (see _base/generate-resolved-view.mjs). Resolved views are generated computed-style companions skipped by index/validator.

css.description: Stylesheets (paths relative to registry root) injected into every tile at generation time. Use when tiles rely on external design-system CSS.

classCheck.description: Class ground-truth validation: every tile-DOM class with `prefix` must be defined by the staticView.css stylesheets or allowlisted here (with reason). Catches hallucinated design-system classes.

reason.description: Why this class is exempt (JS mount, documented no-op, registry demo class)

base.description: Base URL for raw file fetching (raw.githubusercontent.com/...)

additionalFields.description: Non-standard fields included in each tile's metadata

govCompliance.description: Government compliance standards this registry supports

supportedDesignSystems.description: Design systems that have classMapping entries in this registry's tiles (e.g., ['material', 'bootstrap'])

adapterBase.description: Base URL for adapter registry (cross-design system semantic mappings)

compatibilityPath.description: Path to the family-level compatibility map, relative to the registry root (default: compatibility.json; monorepo registries may point at a shared cross/ directory)

enabled.description: Whether this registry ships an MCP server entry point

server.description: Path to the MCP server entry point (relative to registry root)

tools.description: Tool names exposed by the server

gaps.description: Declared component-concept gaps: design-system components or patterns this registry intentionally does not tile, with the nearest available alternative. Agents query this instead of inferring from absence. Doctrine-backed omissions (status not_part_of_design_system) must cite source and state consequence — the registry records doctrine with sources, it never authors it.

concept.description: Component concept name (e.g. combobox, card, mega-menu)

status.description: not_part_of_design_system = doctrine/pattern, do not invent; deferred = candidate for a future tile

nearestAlternative.description: Tiled family or recipe to use instead

consequence.description: What an implementing agent must do instead, as an instruction-shaped consequence (e.g. 'do NOT add a page-level error summary; field-level messaging is the sanctioned pattern'). Required when status is not_part_of_design_system.

source.description: Where the design system documents this omission (URL or citation). Required when status is not_part_of_design_system: the registry records doctrine with sources, it never authors it.

tokenProfiles.description: Named token override sets components can declare support for (e.g. highContrast, darkMode, compactDensity). Keys are profile names; values have description + tokenOverrides.

tokenOverrides.description: Token name → override value applied when this profile is active

behaviorContract.description: When true, validate-registry.mjs enforces instruction.behavior on every tile whose requiresJs is required or optional (tile-format.md Behavior Fields).

patternGuidance.description: When true, the registry publishes Surface 6 pattern guidance (protocol.md): generate-index.mjs emits patterns/index.json and normalizes discovery.patterns into index records; validate-registry.mjs enforces pattern-file rules (required citations, cross-references to real tiles/recipes). Task-to-component-set guidance only — never page design.

modifierSeparators.description: Modifier separators this design system uses (longest first, e.g. ["--", "__", "-"]). Consumed by analysis tooling (e.g. detect-convergence.mjs) to canonicalize class spellings before grouping. See protocol.md Design-System Version Sync and Surface 7.
